He notices the metal rod frame barely flexes while the flexible frame moves naturally.
He pauses and compares the different shapes after bending.

opening_activity: Comparing how flexible and rigid body structures respond to the same bending force.
opening_location: A quiet engineering display room with simple material demonstration models.
opening_environment: A calm exhibit space with a small table holding body structure models and the storybook nearby.

curiosity_trigger: The surprising mismatch between a strong-looking metal frame and its limited movement makes the scholar question whether strength alone helps a body.
trigger_object: The side-by-side flexible and metal body frame models.
reaction: He pauses with quiet surprise and studies the less flexible metal frame.
